name: ehr-governance-packet
description: Build a normalized JSON quality-governance packet from the read-only EHR governance API. Use for any task that hands you a prompt.txt plus an input/payloads/answer_template.json and asks you to produce JSON about duplicate-chart merge readiness, referral coordination, care-transition handoff, duplicate/ServiceRequest validation, or referral-batch audit, driven by a base URL described in environment_access.md.
